capabilities: Create chat notes that render messages with a chat input field
Write Markdown messages with replies, pins, edits and emoji reactions
Search messages with author, date and reaction filters
Import Discord server data into chat notes
Override appearance settings per note via frontmatter keys
disambiguation: Not a real messenger; it only imitates chat behavior locally and cannot send messages to other users or devices.
extras: The README warns to back up Discord data before importing since the plugin can change or delete it. It states the plugin works entirely locally and collects no data. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author originally designed it to export Discord servers into Obsidian, and for drafting dialogues or keeping timestamped ideas separated in one file.
problem: Obsidian notes have no message-based layout, so writing dialogues or timestamped message exchanges in one file is hard to keep readable and separate.

relations.evidence: This plugin was originally designed to export Discord servers into Obsidian

summary: Messenger-style chat notes that render message threads with an input field, replies, pins, reactions and filtered search inside a note.
